$comment: Stage 6 control bands for the engagement stack — see docs/sdlc/intents/2026-09-04-engage-control-bands. A band is a series id from /api/series with a stable baseline. Detection is deterministic (scripts/control-bands.mjs, Western Electric rules 1-4); a model is never in the path that decides a breach. Only rates and gauges are banded — a cumulative series trends forever.
